title: Origin story: Tyr
description: Tyr was the bravest of the Aesir, god of the formal oath and the thing-assembly's law. When the gods needed to bind the wolf Fenrir, only Tyr dared place his hand in the beast's jaws as pledge of good faith. When Fenrir found the chain unbreakable, he took Tyr's hand — and Tyr did not flinch.
